previous_statement: Lemma 4.2 (Concentration of GKKT): The averaged estimator rho_hat_avg = (1/n) sum_i rho_hat_i satisfies Pr[||rho_hat_avg - |v><v|||_infty >= q] <= 2 exp((4 log 3)d - n*q^2/704). Proof: (i) Fix a unit vector |z> and apply the Bernstein inequality for sub-exponential random variables [FR13, Theorem 7.30] using the moment bounds from Lemma 4.1, giving Pr[|<z|rho_hat_avg - |v><v||z>| >= q] <= 2 exp(-n*q^2/704). (ii) Take a (1/3)-covering net N of the unit sphere with |N| <= (3/(1/3))^{2d} = 9^{2d} points [Ver18, Cor. 4.2.11]. (iii) Union bound over N, then extend to all |z> via the covering net argument [Ver18, Lemma 4.4.2] which shows ||A||_infty <= 2 max_{z in N} |<z|A|z>| for Hermitian A.
new_statement: Lemma 4.2 (Concentration of GKKT): The averaged estimator rho_hat_avg = (1/n) sum_i rho_hat_i satisfies Pr[||rho_hat_avg - |v><v|||_infty >= q] <= 2 exp((4 log 3)d - n*q^2/704). Proof: (i) Fix a unit vector |z> and apply the Bernstein inequality for sub-exponential random variables [FR13, Theorem 7.30] using the moment bounds from Lemma 4.1, giving Pr[|<z|rho_hat_avg - |v><v||z>| >= q] <= 2 exp(-n*q^2/704). (ii) Take a (1/4)-covering net N of the unit sphere in C^d. The sphere has real dimension 2d-1, so the net has |N| <= (1 + 2/(1/4))^{2d} = 9^{2d} points [Ver18, Cor. 4.2.11]. (iii) Union bound over N: Pr[max_{z in N} |<z|A|z>| >= q] <= 2 * 9^{2d} * exp(-n*q^2/704). (iv) Extend to all |z| via the covering net argument [Ver18, Lemma 4.4.2]: for any Hermitian A, ||A||_infty <= (1/(1-2*theta)) max_{z in N} |<z|A|z>| with theta = 1/4, giving ||A||_infty <= 2 max_{z in N} |<z|A|z>|. Combining: Pr[||A||_infty >= 2q] <= 2 exp(2d*ln(9) - n*q^2/704) = 2 exp((4 log 3)d - n*q^2/704), where 2*ln(9) = 4*ln(3).
